TextView.android:text: Circle anything on screen, search it with Google Lens.
Open in floating window (off = full screen)
Paste copied text and press Enter
The search area is shared: the area you save in "Saved search area" is used by both Circle Search and ChatGPT.

Copy a question, then tap the edge handle of Grok, Claude, ChatGPT (with screen capture off) or any app you added. It opens (floating or full screen, see the Floating window switch on each handle), pastes your prompt + the copied text and sends it.
Add my prompt before the copied text
Keeps running in the background until you turn this off. No notifications are shown.

Makes the app a foreground service so clearing Recents doesn't stop it. Its tiny notification is silent and sits at the bottom of the shade; you can hide it in system notification settings and the protection stays.

One tap on a handle does its job. The top handle starts Circle Search (or searches your saved area). Switch on Clipboard below to add a clipboard handle under it. Every app you add gets its own colour-coded handle that opens the app in a floating window. Press, hold and drag any handle to move them all together along the screen edge.

At 0% the handles are invisible but still work. App shortcuts open in a floating window only if your phone allows freeform windows (Developer options: Enable freeform windows); otherwise they open normally.

Save a spot on the screen (shared by Circle Search and ChatGPT). Then every tap on the edge handle searches that spot directly, with no circling. Remove it and the handle opens the lasso as usual. You can also save the area from the lasso screen ("Save search area" button).
